title: Celestial Lobster Gathering
description: A surreal night scene shows a massive orange lobster emerging from a stone balcony on the right, surrounded by glowing sparks. Below, a vast crowd of silhouetted figures gathers along a winding river that flows through a vibrant orange and purple mountain valley under a cosmic sky with a glowing spiral galaxy and rings.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at night featuring a giant detailed orange lobster crawling out of an ornate stone balcony on the right with magical sparks. A huge crowd of people viewed from behind gathers in the foreground along both sides of a glowing blue winding river that cuts through orange and purple mountains. The sky is a vibrant cosmic scene with a bright central sun surrounded by swirling galaxy rings and stars, framed by large stylized colorful leaves in the corners, vibrant colors, detailed digital painting.
